summary: This package root directory serves as the primary entry point and integration hub for the AI layer, consolidating core sub-modules that handle agents, models, execution, routing, tools, prompts, providers, and error handling.
responsibilities: Export public APIs and modules for the entire AI layer
Aggregate core sub-components including agents, models, execution contexts, routing, tools, prompts, and providers
Provide centralized error handling and domain-specific failure diagnostics
relationships: The root index exports all public modules, models, providers, routing logic, and tools to external consumers.
Sub-modules such as routing, models, and execution coordinate through the exported package surface to handle AI requests.
designDecisions: Re-exporting all sub-module indexes from a single entry point to simplify consumer imports
Modularizing functionality into distinct directories like models, routing, tools, and execution to separate concerns
